transition: selected = hint OR not a0 OR b0+1>=K; a1=selected ? (v=0) : a0; b1=selected ? 0 : b0+1
invariant: 0<=b<K AND (available AND NOT truth implies b>0)
method: For each obligation first require SAT premises, then UNSAT premises AND negated goal. Preserve SMT-LIB input, stdout, proof output and solver identity. Unknown/error is failure.
limits: A handwritten transition formalization, not a proof extracted from production code.
Symbolic obligations plus a separate induction/rank argument justify the bound; solver output alone is not a full trace theorem.
One pinned SMT solver is trusted; proof objects are saved but not checked by an independent proof kernel.
Initial available claim assumed true; completed transitions only; fixed claim, history and validator contract.
No real-validator soundness, wall-time, crash recovery, truth labels, actual probes or main-cohort evaluation is established.
